cues: Here are the ones to know.
Ethoxyethane, diethyl ether, often just called ether.
Two methoxy two methylpropane, known as M T B E, a petrol additive.
And on the ring side, methoxybenzene, called anisole, and phenoxybenzene, diphenyl ether.
text: Here are the ones to know. Methoxymethane, dimethyl ether. Ethoxyethane, diethyl ether, often just called ether. One methoxypropane and two methoxypropane. Two methoxy two methylpropane, known as M T B E, a petrol additive. And on the ring side, methoxybenzene, called anisole, and phenoxybenzene, diphenyl ether.
